_doc: Round 5 paint-over for n1 at 144 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/n1_144.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (-1, -1), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: face_base
layers.why: Face critic 2: clear the old stamp to a clean face plane (FC-P35).

layers.name: eye
layers.why: Face critic 2: 'the lash mass with an outer flick, a dark-to-light iris, a catchlight'; in profile the eye is a wedge: the lash sweeps back into a flick, the iris is a half-oval at the front. A two-row lash (the first try) read as a dark slab at 144, so the lash is one row plus the flick.

layers.name: brow
layers.why: N1 is the thrust: a set brow, angled down to the front.

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: MOVESET N1: a set line mouth, one dark corner.
